statement: MicroLens development evidence showed a persistent cold/warm tradeoff across MOSAIC variants.
limitation: Exploratory DEVELOPMENT evidence; it is not a promotion claim.
prohibited_stronger_formulation: The tradeoff proves a universal cold-start law.

statement: The local PixelRec50K publisher image and MiniLM text feature indices align on all 82,865 track items, with finite vectors and mapped metadata.
limitation: Local feature QA only; no external model replication or redistribution permission follows.

statement: The official PixelRec cover archive passed full CRC and all 82,865 image names mapped one-to-one to metadata item IDs.
limitation: No image was independently encoded; derived-feature rights remain held.
prohibited_stronger_formulation: Raw-cover transformations or feature redistribution are authorized.

statement: On MicroLens LOCKED_FINAL, M1_T2 exceeded B4_TWO_TOWER_T3 controlled-cold NDCG@20 by 0.008940 in the point estimate.
limitation: The paired 95% interval [-0.000194, 0.019205] crossed zero, so the frozen cold superiority gate failed.

statement: On MicroLens LOCKED_FINAL, M1_T2 was 0.023619 NDCG@20 below B7_BERT4REC_T3 on FIT-warm items and failed the frozen noninferiority gate.
limitation: Applies to the frozen p1 data, candidates, ensemble, and offline metric.

statement: M1_T2 improved overall MicroLens LOCKED_FINAL NDCG@20 over B7_BERT4REC_T3 by 0.007482, with paired 95% interval [0.006634, 0.008332].
limitation: Secondary evidence cannot replace the failed co-primary cold and warm gates.
prohibited_stronger_formulation: MOSAIC passed the primary promotion criterion.

statement: Protocol mosaic-rec-2026-09-20-p1 supports RETAIN_BASELINE because both frozen co-primary promotion gates failed.
limitation: This decision is specific to p1 and does not establish that multimodal recommendation cannot help in other protocols.

statement: The local development API completed 100 sequential recommendation requests without error at 4.49 ms median latency on the RTX 4090 Laptop GPU.
limitation: Single-process local demonstration using a development checkpoint; no production capacity or SLA claim.

statement: MOSAIC improves controlled-cold NDCG@20 while retaining warm quality.
limitation: Cold superiority and warm noninferiority both failed their frozen gates.

statement: MOSAIC has calibrated reliability-aware gate behavior.
limitation: Confirmatory robustness definitions were underspecified before protected access; gate weights are not calibrated probabilities.

statement: The locked MicroLens result replicated on MovieLens 32M or PixelRec50K.
limitation: Only FIT input preparation and development popularity pilots exist; no frozen transfer model result was executed.
Public observational offline data cannot establish production effect.
Only one physical GPU was available and no multi-GPU measurement exists.
